record.bible_text: Come near<WH07126><WTH8798>, ye nations<WH01471>, to hear<WH08085><WTH8800>; and hearken<WH07181><WTH8685>, ye people<WH03816>: let the earth<WH0776> hear<WH08085><WTH8799>, and all that is therein<WH04393>; the world<WH08398>, and all things that come forth<WH06631> of it. <RF>all that...: Heb. the fulness thereof<Rf>

And the unicorns<WH07214> shall come down<WH03381><WTH8804> with them, and the bullocks<WH06499> with the bulls<WH047>; and their land<WH0776> shall be soaked<WH07301><WTH8765> with blood<WH01818>, and their dust<WH06083> made fat<WH01878><WTH8792> with fatness<WH02459>. <RF>unicorns: or, rhinocerots<Rf> <RF>soaked: or, drunken<Rf>
For <FI>it is<Fi> the day<WH03117> of the LORD'S<WH03068> vengeance<WH05359>, <FI>and<Fi> the year<WH08141> of recompences<WH07966> for the controversy<WH07379> of Zion<WH06726>.<CM>

And the streams<WH05158> thereof shall be turned<WH02015><WTH8738> into pitch<WH02203>, and the dust<WH06083> thereof into brimstone<WH01614>, and the land<WH0776> thereof shall become burning<WH01197><WTH8802> pitch<WH02203>.

It shall not be quenched<WH03518><WTH8799> night<WH03915> nor day<WH03119>; the smoke<WH06227> thereof shall go up<WH05927><WTH8799> for ever<WH05769>: from generation<WH01755> to generation<WH01755> it shall lie waste<WH02717><WTH8799>; none shall pass through<WH05674><WTH8802> it for ever<WH05331> and ever<WH05331>.

They shall call<WH07121><WTH8799> the nobles<WH02715> thereof to the kingdom<WH04410>, but none <FI>shall be<Fi> there, and all her princes<WH08269> shall be nothing<WH0657>.

There shall the great owl<WH07091> make her nest<WH07077><WTH8765>, and lay<WH04422><WTH8762>, and hatch<WH01234><WTH8804>, and gather<WH01716><WTH8804> under her shadow<WH06738>: there shall the vultures<WH01772> also be gathered<WH06908><WTH8738>, every one<WH0802> with her mate<WH07468>.
